description: AI Agents: Use to see when a calendar of an AI agent's system still has room, such as before proposing a time to a customer, for at most 31 days at a time. Not for what is booked already (use search_records on appointments).

calendar.description: The calendar's id, from describe_record_type with include stages on appointments; left out where the system keeps one company schedule.

duration_minutes.description: How long the visit or meeting takes, in minutes, where the system works slots out by length.

from.description: The first day or moment, ISO 8601, such as 2026-11-02.

system.description: The AI agent's system or connection name.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone to give the slots in, such as Europe/Amsterdam.

to.description: The last day or moment, ISO 8601, at most 31 days later; a day counts in full.

user.description: Only the slots of this user, by the id describe_record_type gives with include users.

name: find_free_slots
title: Find free calendar slots
